run_quadruped_simulation: run the pybullet GUI simulation that loads the SPIRIT40 quadruped robot URDF and steps the physics loop
load_urdf_robot: load the SPIRIT40 quadruped robot URDF model into a pybullet simulation with a movable base
reset_joint_positions: reset the 12 revolute joint states of the quadruped robot to predefined position values
control_joints_position: set position control on each revolute joint of the quadruped robot using pybullet POSITION_CONTROL
query_joint_info: print joint information for all joints of the loaded quadruped robot using getJointInfo
